Healthy eating doesn't have to be boring! Discover four delicious ways to enjoy the goodness of millets with recipes that bring together nutrition, flavour and creativity.
In this video, we're making:
Instant Millet Handvo – A wholesome baked snack packed with vegetables and topped with a flavourful tempering.
Foxtail Millet Papdi Chaat – A crispy, tangy and delicious twist on everyone's favourite chaat.
Kodo Pea Risotto – A creamy and comforting dish made with kodo millet, green peas, parmesan and mint.
